$schema_note: Strings the entire Digi Setu UI uses. Keys are organised by feature so adding a second language is a matter of duplicating this file (e.g. hi.json, es.json) and translating. The convention: short fragments (buttons, labels, mode names) live here; long-form prose (Privacy / Terms paragraphs) stays inline in the .vue template — translators clone the file in those rare cases.

permission.appliesToChat: Applies to {bold} from the next tool call onward.

auto.label: Auto
auto.blurb: Run every tool without asking. Every action is still recorded in the audit log.

ask.label: Ask
ask.blurb: Ask before shell commands, file edits, and background processes. Reads pass silently.

cautious.label: Cautious
cautious.blurb: Ask before every tool call, including reads and searches. Most cautious.

buttons.allowTitle: Allow this single call. Digi Setu will ask again next time. (↵)
buttons.alwaysAllowTitle: Allow this AND every future call with the same arguments for the rest of this chat. (⇧↵)
buttons.alwaysDenyTitle: Deny this AND every future call with the same arguments for the rest of this chat.
buttons.denyTitle: Deny this single call. Digi Setu will ask again next time. (esc)
